quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Global premium spirits compounder anchored by iconic Jack Daniel's trademark and aged barrel inventory moat. Peak Owner EPS of $2.1458 reported in FY2024 included an unrepeatable $267M pre-tax (~$0.44 after-tax) windfall gain from the divestiture of the Finlandia vodka business and Sonoma-Cutrer. Peak Owner EPS is calibrated to normalized operating peak of $1.84 (matching FY25 clean diluted EPS). Operating ROIC of 31.60% reflects aged inventory asset backing and high tangible brand return. 5-10Y secular growth g_implied is set to 4.5% (global volume 1.0% + price/mix 2.5% + RTD expansion 1.0% - tariff/input margin drag 0.5% + share repurchases 0.5%) reflecting spirits category normalization post-COVID and moderation headwinds. Conservative balance sheet with net debt under 3x net income ($2.08B debt vs $308M cash) and 9.72x interest coverage. Dividend Aristocrat with 3.1% dividend yield. Stock trades solidly Below PAR at 16.51x current multiple vs 21.49x PAR multiple (-23.2% discount vs $39.54 PAR value; or -34.1% discount vs unadjusted $46.11 PAR value), delivering a 13.2% 5Y expected IRR.
